svg.title: Your first Satori playbook: write, run, assert, report
svg.desc: A 15-second loop. In an editor, the playbook hello.yml is written line by line: a test with assertStdoutEqual "Hello world!\n", assertReturnCode 0, and execute echo Hello world!; the two assert lines are highlighted. In a terminal, satori-v2 run hello.yml --sync --report --output is typed and run. Job status goes from Running to Finished, and the output shows the command echo Hello world!, return code 0 and stdout Hello world!. Both asserts, assertStdoutEqual and assertReturnCode, are marked PASS. A report card shows Passed, 1/1 tests and 2/2 asserts, with Report ID 90412 and its dashboard link. Caption: Write. Run. Assert. Report. A playbook is YAML that checks command behavior.
svg.text: A playbook is YAML that checks command behavior.
